ads_global_enabled.description: Master kill-switch for all advertisements across the app

ad_server_config_json.description: Optional server-side JSON override for ad unit IDs and tier configuration

ad_loading_timeout_ms.description: Maximum milliseconds to wait for ad load before continuing UI flow

ad_interstitial_min_interval_sec.description: Minimum cooldown interval in seconds between interstitial ad displays

ad_interstitial_click_frequency.description: Number of document opens or tool clicks between interstitial ads

ad_startup_format.description: Startup ad format during splash: APP_OPEN, INTERSTITIAL, or NONE

ad_resume_app_open_enabled.description: Show App Open ad when returning to app from background

ad_home_banner_enabled.description: Adaptive banner ad at the bottom of Home screen (true = show, false = hide)

ad_home_banner_format.description: Banner format for Home bottom banner: COLLAPSIBLE (expanding) or STANDARD (steady adaptive)

ad_viewer_banner_enabled.description: Pinned banner ad at the bottom of PDF viewer

ad_exit_dialog_native_enabled.description: Native ad displayed inside the Exit App confirmation dialog

ad_ai_dialog_native_enabled.description: Native ad inside AI tool dialogs

ad_vip_rewarded_enabled.description: Rewarded video ad gating for VIP PDF tools

notif_out_of_app_enabled.description: Master kill-switch for out-of-app engagement notifications

notif_min_interval_hours.description: Minimum cooldown in hours between engagement notifications

notif_exit_delay_ms.description: Delay in milliseconds before firing notification after app exit

notif_countdown_seconds.description: Countdown timer seconds for high-priority heads-up notifications

notif_inactivity_hours.description: Inactivity duration in hours before scheduling re-engagement

notif_periodic_hours.description: Interval in hours for daily document summary WorkManager worker

notif_heads_up_enabled.description: Display high-importance heads-up banners on device screen

notif_full_screen_enabled.description: Allow full-screen lock screen intents for critical alerts

notif_duplicate_accumulate.description: Update existing notification IDs instead of creating multiple shade entries

notif_style_variant.description: Notification style: RICH_BIG_TEXT, BIG_PICTURE, or CUSTOM_VIEW

notif_exit_alert_enabled.description: Trigger reminder notification when user exits to Home or closes the app

notif_screenshot_enabled.description: Trigger 1-tap Convert to PDF notification when user takes a screenshot

notif_downloads_enabled.description: Trigger notification when new documents are detected in Downloads

notif_unlock_enabled.description: Trigger re-engagement check on USER_PRESENT device unlock

notif_file_observer_enabled.description: Enable low-level Linux inotify FileObservers for real-time filesystem tracking

notif_system_dialogs_enabled.description: Trigger local actions when Home or Recents system gestures are detected

notif_messaging_apps_enabled.description: Enable messaging app source attribution for WhatsApp, Telegram, Teams, etc.

notif_periodic_worker_enabled.description: Enable background WorkManager periodic engagement worker

notif_unlock_worker_enabled.description: Enable background WorkManager unlock engagement evaluation

self_launch_on_lock_enabled.description: Allow document alerts to wake screen and display over lock screen

screen_splash_delay_ms.description: Duration in milliseconds of splash screen animation

screen_exit_dialog_variant.description: Exit dialog layout variant: STANDARD, NATIVE_AD, or RETENTION

screen_tools_vip_action.description: Unlocking mechanism for VIP tools: REWARDED or VIP_PASS

reader_render_quality.description: PDF page rendering quality: STANDARD (1.5x) or HIGH (2.0x)

feature_ai_tools_enabled.description: Toggle visibility of AI PDF summarizer and translator tools

feature_image_to_pdf_limit.description: Maximum number of images allowed in a single batch conversion

feature_night_mode_enabled.description: Enable PDF viewer dark mode / inverted color reading mode

feature_recent_files_tab.description: Show dedicated Recent Files tab on the bottom navigation bar

feature_scanner_alias_enabled.description: Dynamically show secondary PDF Scanner app icon on user home screen

cohort_ad_aggressiveness.description: Ad density tier: AGGRESSIVE, BALANCED, or LIGHT

cohort_override_topic.description: FCM messaging topic for targeting specific user cohorts

analytics_sampling_rate.description: Event logging sampling rate between 0.0 and 1.0
